comment: Copy into <workspace>/.devin/autonom-config.json and fill in the {{…}} placeholders. The hooks, the autonom-coord-mcp server, and the Team Room extension read this. `policy` screens tool calls and `salience` gates the unread-message stop alert; each is true (default backend), a backend name ("openjev", "typesafe", "decider"), or false. `memory` gates the session-start notes read.
